worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.summary: Lunge and clamp down, then whip the target to one chosen side: this is the family's heaviest direct bite, the whip shoves the target out of position and pins it briefly by weight, and a hard enough shake stuns it and interrupts what it was doing. The cost is no lasting debuff.
The clamping bite deals %1$s contact damage.
It pounces up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a %3$s block fang radius.

On a hit it whips the target a total of %2$s blocks to the side chosen in its configuration over 3 ticks and pins it for %1$s; while pinned it cannot move, but it can still use moves and make ordinary attacks. The whip stops at the real displacement when blocked.
A landed shake has a %1$s chance to flinch the target for %2$s, interrupting interruptible actions; while flinched it cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.shake.on: Whipping style: whips harder, pins longer and flinches more often, but the single bite is ×0.9 and the wind-up and cooldown are longer.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.shake.off: Clamping style: the single bite is ×1.1 and it casts faster, but the shove, pin and flinch are all smaller.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s and the flinch chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.use.0: Land the family's heaviest single bite
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.use.1: Clamp down and whip the target, pinning it briefly
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.use.2: Stun a target and interrupt what it is doing
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.preference.s: On: whips harder, pins longer and flinches more often, but the single bite is ×0.9 and the wind-up and cooldown are longer. Off: a clamping bite - ×1.1 single hit and faster to cast, but a smaller shove, pin and flinch.
After the bite the target is always whipped to this side of the release direction: right or left. Repeated casts no longer pick a random side, so the enemy can be steered clear of allies.
worldcombat.skill.hyperfang.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first; larger chases harder.
On: prefer a target that is currently pinned and add another bite. Off: treat Hyper Fang as an ordinary melee heavy bite.

On: when the configured whip side points at an ally, lower this move's priority and wait for a spot that whips the enemy away from allies. Off: ignore ally positions and sort it as an ordinary heavy bite.
